proof_body:
by
  intro G X _ _ _ H x
  constructor
  · intro hH g
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq H x (g • x)
    refine ⟨h, h.2, (h:G)⁻¹ * g, ?_, by simp⟩
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, mul_smul, ← hh]
    simp [Subgroup.smul_def]
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
    have key : ∀ y : X, ∃ k : H, k • x = y := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G x y
      obtain ⟨h1, hh1, s, hs, rfl⟩ := h g
      refine ⟨⟨h1, hh1⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff] at hs
      simp [Subgroup.smul_def, mul_smul, hs]
    obtain ⟨k1, rfl⟩ := key a
    obtain ⟨k2, rfl⟩ := key b
    exact ⟨k2 * k1⁻¹, by simp [mul_smul]⟩
target_source: ∀ (G X : Type*) [Group G] [MulAction G X] [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] (H : Subgroup G) (x : X), MulAction.IsPretransitive H X ↔ ∀ g : G, ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ s ∈ MulAction.stabilizer G x, g = h * s
